probes.question: Which file's Step 2 governs how the next version bump is classified from the diff at release time?
What is the highest release of this repo recorded in the project file, and on what date did it ship?
Which file should an agent read first when the user just says "continue" or "carry on"?
What is the prescribed way to shrink the project instructions file?
probes.answer: Delete duplication and name the authority; never compress prose or re-inline reference material.

probes.question: What self-drift check should be done at the start of any session?
probes.answer: Compare the file's version line against CHANGELOG.md and surface any newer shipped version before starting.

probes.question: What command verifies skill installation after installing, moving, or removing a skill?
Which lint rule catches a skill edited in only one of its two locations?
Before writing "Closes #N" on an issue filed against a skill, what must you do?
probes.answer: Name the adopter-installed file that changed because of it, confirming the concept actually appears in the template diff.

probes.question: Which lint rules SKIP in CI, making the local lint run stronger?
probes.answer: Rules 2, 12, 15, 18 and 19, plus 21 while the top CHANGELOG block is a candidate.

probes.question: Which file defines this repo's review tiers?
Which file defines the CI workflow that runs lint and fixtures?
Which file is the tool-agnostic naming map and the authority on install paths?
When you change docs/GUIDE.md, what other file should you check for the same change?
What does the single external citation in the verification rationale support?
probes.answer: Only the premise, not the principles.

probes.question: Does the /release skill perform the tagging, and where is the tag-and-push protocol documented?
probes.answer: No, it stops before tagging; the protocol is in the CHANGELOG.md header.

probes.question: Which template should a new multi-session work-item file be created from?
Which section of a work-item file acts as the savepoint when resuming an initiative?
Which skill should be run when ending a session, after updating work-item savepoints?
Which skill should be run monthly or after major restructuring?
Which user-level location is reserved only for cross-project user, feedback and reference memory?
Under the v1.10.1 precedent, what semver bump does a documentation-only change get?
Which file records the 2026-04-14 positioning decision not to re-promote the framework wrapper?
Which file holds the authoritative running total for the "Author green-lights own procedural artifact" row?
What three checks are required before green-lighting an edited shipped procedural artifact?
probes.answer: A cross-step and cross-file contract re-read, a hostile-repo test, and seeded true positives, followed by a review run.

probes.question: How must a negative claim like "0 rows" or "all clean" be reported?
probes.answer: With the command that produced it and what a non-empty result would have looked like.

probes.question: Which file gives the account of why seeds drawn from already-handled cases are not a measurement?
Which skills stay project-local rather than shipping global, because of shadowing?
Which content must avoid assuming Claude Code, and which may be Claude-specific?
probes.answer: Adopter-facing content (README.md, adopt.md, templates/, docs/GUIDE.md) must be tool-agnostic; maintainer infrastructure may be Claude-specific.

probes.question: Which fixture script do adopters run for audit-context Step 4, so that a fix there ships to them?
What command should you use before asserting how a memory entry or heading got that way?
